chapter_notes_tr: Malikâne sahneleri kayıp sayfayı, mühür izini ve eli olmayan saati bir araya getirir. Fadyme ağır büyü kullandığında belirtileri saklamayı sürdürür.

scenes.direction_en: Sable opens the servants’ entrance from inside. A dozen servants wait in the dark, afraid to speak above a whisper.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Enemies that reach the Rear are marked in advance. Auto prioritizes immediate threats to healers unless you change the policy.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: No names until we are outside. The walls listen here.
There are children under the stair. I can get them out.
Take the rear passage. We will keep the sentinel busy.

post_battle_lines.text_en: They are safe. I thought my hands would shake more.
They did shake. You still opened the door.
That is often what courage looks like.
There is a row of graves behind this wing. No names. I am coming back for them.

scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_ch6_estate — whispering, soft clock ticks that stop and start | post: bgm_warmth (muted)

scenes.direction_en: The gallery contains portraits with their nameplates cut away. Mirel and Aveline arrive with the cathedral folio; Odelia's message found them. In one portrait, a court official's gloved hand rests beside a watch with no hands.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: Someone removed the names but left the faces. A very specific kind of cowardice.
Or a person trying to hide the victims from the rite.
This woman has the same bell pin as Fadyme.

post_battle_lines.text_en: She was my mother.
You never told me she was here.
I was not sure I remembered her correctly.
Then we will remember the portrait for you.
Wait. The order that cut these names was copied in my hand. I was a court scribe. I never asked whose names they were.
Then you know how easily it happens. That is not the same as choosing it.

scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_ch6_estate (uneasy layer) | post: bgm_fadyme_theme + bgm_ledger_motif together on 'She was my mother.'

scenes.direction_en: Vespera’s glass lantern reveals three hidden anchors around the conservatory. Thistle and Iona, who followed the same message up from the Undercity, set up a field infirmary beneath a stone arch.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Remove this ward with a matching support skill or destroy its three anchors. No featured banner hero is required.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: This ward is drinking time from the glass. Slowly. Patiently.
I saw this ward beneath the city, in the Guild's lowest cistern. I left before I understood what it was drinking.
Then we will stop it before it drinks from anyone else.
Break the anchors or let Vespera unwind the seal. Either path is safe.

post_battle_lines.text_en: Someone taught the glass to remember a room that is gone.
Can a room miss someone?
A room can keep an absence. That is close enough.
Th-then we plant something in it. Absences hate that.

scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_ch6_estate with glass harmonics (Vespera's lantern) | post: bgm_revelation (soft)

scenes.direction_en: The manor shudders. Fadyme holds a stone arch above a trapped child; the recovered ledger lies open beside a handless-watch drawing.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: The rescue timer is shown beside the wave counter. Defeat the marked enemy before the beam falls; a missed optional rescue does not erase the main story.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: Let the arch go. I have the child.
I have it. Go.
Fadyme, your sleeve—
Dust. It is only dust.
Hana. Please do not tell him.
I will not. But I saw it.

post_battle_lines.text_en: Seven notches. The same seal. And these initials: C.V.
The handless watch was in the portrait.
The name is not in the ledger. We should keep moving.
The letters have found us again. I know whose hand wrote them.

scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_tension (the manor shudders) | post: bgm_clockless — first hint (pizzicato only) under 'C.V.'

scenes.direction_en: An old noble’s Wraith steps out of its portrait frame. It wears the same face as every blank nameplate in the gallery.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: The Wraith copies its shield from the gallery. Break the mirror frame to stop new copies.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: A house remembers its master. A kingdom remembers its heir.
I hid the bell-keeper's daughter from the Crown. I kept her face and lost her name.
It is copying the portraits. Break the mirror frame.
Then we end the memory.

post_battle_lines.text_en: The page is not a cure. It is a schedule for the bells.
A schedule for what?
For the heir. The ink says no more.
Then we find the altar before the next line is written.

scenes.battle_transition_en: The party escorts survivors and separates onto safe roads before reuniting at the First Eclipse Altar.
scenes.music_cue: pre: bgm_ch6_estate (chaotic layer) | battle: bgm_boss_wraith | post: bgm_ledger_motif on 'a schedule for the bells'

scenes.direction_en: The estate road climbs through soot-dark pines. A lantern flickers three times from a high window. On the milestone below it, a gray seven-notched seal, still soft.

lines.text_en: Sable. She said she would open a door from inside.
She opens doors for others and never walks through first. People like that keep their word.
Gray wax on the milestone, still soft. She passed here this morning. She is ahead of us.
Then she reaches the altar before we do.

scenes.music_cue: bgm_road (soot pines, lantern signal) → bgm_bell_widow motif (handbell only) at the soft gray seal

scenes.direction_en: Dawn among the estate ruins. The company divides to reach the altar by safe roads.

lines.text_en: The schedule points to the First Eclipse Altar. Everyone go by different roads. Fewer targets.
The servants and the wounded go with Nara and Marek.
Fadyme. I am still not telling. But please be careful on the stairs.
I will be the most careful person on any stair.
We meet at the altar. All of us.

scenes.music_cue: bgm_camp (dawn version) → bgm_held_the_road (first quiet statement) as the company divides
